ledger.note: 1989: the Third Republic is established. 'from 20 August 1949 until the establishment of the current Republic of Hungary on 23 October 1989'; infobox 'Third Republic: 23 October 1989' (the Hungary page agrees); the constitutional amendments 'changed Hungary's official name to the Republic of Hungary'. The pages give the date, not a boundary: the land is the People's Republic's, unchanged (Cliopatria's Hungary row resumes in 1990 on the same outline).

certainty.note: The frontier is the Trianon one as confirmed on 10 February 1947 (effective 15 September 1947); the 1990s basic treaties with Romania, Slovakia and Ukraine 'renounce all outstanding territorial claims' (page, undated).

notes: Hungary since the establishment of the Third Republic on 23 October 1989 (Republic of Hungary), under the Cliopatria row 'Hungary' (Q28513) from 1990. REPAIR PASS 2026-11-01: the reviewer failed the earlier dossier, which ran 1946-2024 and called 1949 and 1989 renames while hungarian-people-s-republic held the same land from 20 August 1949 to 23 October 1989 (two states on one land, and a rename means 'colour and dossier continue'). I accept the finding: the Second Republic (1 February 1946 to 20 August 1949) is now the new dossier second-hungarian-republic (it reviews hungary_1947 and a new 1946 keyframe, and carries the 1947 loss of the three villages near Bratislava); this dossier starts at the People's Republic's end and founds from it. The People's Republic is not merged: its page names the Second Republic as predecessor and the Third Hungarian Republic as successor, and the batch writes one dossier per regime elsewhere (People's Republic of Bulgaria, Socialist Republic of Romania). The dossier hungarian-people-s-republic (another part of eu-22) names 'hungary' as predecessor and as the counterpart of its 1949 found event; both should now read second-hungarian-republic (its successor 'hungary' is already right). Q28513 is also on austria-hungary and hungarian-nationalists: different states (the dual monarchy and the 1956-57 revolutionary row), not merged. The Hungary page reports no border change after 1947: shapes 1990-2024 differ only by drawing noise (91,850 to 92,125 km2 against the infobox's 93,030 km2). The 1989 keyframe is new (shape unchanged) because Cliopatria's row resumes in 1990. Not on the pages opened: the 2012 renaming (Fundamental Law), the Soviet withdrawal completed in 1991 (HPR page: agreement of April 1989, 'by June 1991'), heads of state (so no ruler strip), the date of the basic treaties. Associations (NATO 1999, EU 2004, Schengen 2007) are not territory. Gazetteer names: none missing. Disagreement with the reviewer: none.
